name: m2734-pour
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, bright clear daylight. Close shot of one anonymous RIGHT hand tilting a small clay jug: a clear steady stream of water flows out of the jug's open MOUTH (spout) down into a simple clay cup standing on a woven palm-leaf mat, sparkling, a few droplets. The water comes only from the mouth of the jug. Only the right hand and forearm in a plain undyed period sleeve - no face, no head, no left hand. Background softly blurred: green date palms and a blue sky. Vibrant fresh colours, no modern objects.
